title.zh: RV Capital 二十周年：塑造投资人的六段经历
title.en: 20-Year Anniversary of RV Capital: Six Life Periods Shaping an Investor

lead.zh: 2026 年 8 月 17 日，RV Capital 迎来二十周年。创始人 Rob Vinall 回顾了塑造其个人与投资策略的六个关键人生阶段，并探讨了价值投资在 AI 时代、地缘政治及市场波动中的核心逻辑。
lead.en: On August 17, 2026, RV Capital marked its twentieth anniversary. Founder Rob Vinall reflected on six pivotal life periods that shaped his character and investment philosophy, while examining the core logic of value investing amidst AI shifts, geopolitical tensions, and market volatility.

heading.zh: 超越短期业绩：投资组合的内在韧性
heading.en: Beyond Short-Term Performance: The Resilience of the Portfolio

paragraphs.zh: 尽管上半年 headline 数据表现平平，但组合底层资产的实际进展显著强劲。这反映了长期价值策略在波动市场中的真实韧性，而非单纯依赖短期估值修复。
paragraphs.en: Despite flat headline performance in the first half, the underlying progress of the portfolio is significantly stronger. This reflects the true resilience of long-term value strategies in volatile markets, rather than relying solely on short-term valuation repairs.

heading.zh: 价值与动量：在 AI 热潮中的决策框架
heading.en: Value vs. Momentum: A Decision Framework in the AI Boom

paragraphs.zh: 面对人工智能热潮，投资者需抉择：是买入低于内在价值的公司并等待价格回归，还是追逐拥有强劲叙事但估值拉伸的企业？RV Capital 坚持前者，认为价格终将反映价值。
paragraphs.en: Facing the AI boom, investors must choose: buy companies below intrinsic value trusting price will eventually reflect it, or chase firms with strong narratives despite stretched valuations? RV Capital insists on the former, believing price will ultimately reflect value.

paragraphs.zh: 同时，需警惕将当前 AI 繁荣视为 1990 年代互联网泡沫的简单重复。历史类比需谨慎，技术范式与监管环境已发生根本变化。
paragraphs.en: Simultaneously, one must avoid simply equating the current AI boom with the late-1990s dot-com bubble. Historical analogies require caution, as technological paradigms and regulatory environments have fundamentally changed.

heading.zh: 地缘政治与新兴市场：超越贸易战的视角
heading.en: Geopolitics and Emerging Markets: Beyond the Trade War

paragraphs.zh: 讨论贸易战时，不能仅局限于双边关税。必须纳入中国更广泛的发展动态，包括人工智能、电动汽车及中国企业的崛起对全球配置的影响。
paragraphs.en: When discussing the trade war, one cannot limit analysis to bilateral tariffs. Broader developments in China—including AI, electric vehicles, and the rising prominence of Chinese companies—must be integrated into global allocation strategies.

paragraphs.zh: 投资者常高估中国监管对企业的冲击，而低估了本土创新生态的适应性。准确预判未来比回避风险更为关键。
paragraphs.en: Investors often overestimate the impact of Chinese regulation on firms while underestimating the adaptability of local innovation ecosystems. Accurately forecasting the future is more critical than avoiding risk.

heading.zh: 复利企业与内在价值：偏斜分布的应对之道
heading.en: Compounders and Intrinsic Value: Managing Skewed Distributions

paragraphs.zh: “复利企业”备受追捧，但其可持续性存疑。高偏度收益（skewness）并不能免除计算内在价值的必要性，否则易陷入叙事陷阱。
paragraphs.en: "Compounders" are popular, but their sustainability is questionable. High skewness does not obviate the need to calculate intrinsic value; otherwise, investors risk falling into narrative traps.

paragraphs.zh: 早期上市企业投资需结合行业洞察与财务纪律。例如 Slack 的投资案例表明，技术优势必须转化为可量化的现金流才能支撑长期持有。
paragraphs.en: Investing in early-stage listed businesses requires industry insight combined with financial discipline. The Slack investment case illustrates that technological advantages must translate into quantifiable cash flows to justify long-term holding.
